description: This file defines the ForeignKey class representing a FOREIGN KEY constraint in Spark's SQL connector catalog. It includes properties for referencing columns, referenced table, and referenced columns, along with methods for equality, hash code, and building instances.

classes.name: ForeignKey
classes.description: Represents a FOREIGN KEY constraint, including referencing columns, referenced table, referenced columns, and validation status.

classes.name: ForeignKey.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing ForeignKey instances with specified properties.

methods.name: referencedColumns
methods.description: Returns the referenced columns in the referenced table.

methods.name: definition
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the foreign key constraint.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another ForeignKey object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code for the ForeignKey object.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a ForeignKey instance.
